rules: Constitution principle II and engineering.md: exhaustive inward layers, independent adapters, canonical facade exclusion, SDK/prompt/effect ownership and acyclic siblings.

modules.responsibility: Map fetch command arguments and describe opt-in per-task debug output truthfully.
modules.interface: Supported options, defaults and dispatch remain unchanged; only explanatory help text changes.
modules.effects: Existing incoming command owns prompts/arguments; no effect or behavior changes.

modules.responsibility: Command registry/dispatch and top-level error boundary.
modules.interface: Registry and public command/exit behavior remain unchanged; ignore help says excluded rather than in-progress.
modules.effects: No new effects; existing incoming dispatch/error rendering remains.

contracts.rules: Exhaustive inward layers, adapter independence and protected SDK imports cover every changed runtime module.
Production effect ownership and forbidden import/effect negative fixtures; canonical facade exclusion and no eager SDK loading.

checks.command: uv run lint-imports && uv run python scripts/check_architecture.py && uv run pytest tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Production graph/effects pass; existing forbidden dependency/effect negative fixtures reject violations.

checks.command: uv run pytest tests/test_output.py tests/test_review_dataset.py tests/test_cvat_diagnostics.py tests/bundle/test_remote.py tests/test_cli_parsing.py tests/test_fetch_task.py
checks.expectation: All lexical/dimension combinations remain covered; public prewrite probes and HTTP lifecycle scenarios pass; no supported CLI behavior changes.
Maintained documentation signatures, configuration, commands and local links/anchors pass.
Real pre-commit in disposable Git repositories stops before mutation on version failure/lock rewrite and executes all hooks on valid prerequisites.

documentation: Correct docs/configuration.md and docs/cli.md; update CONTRIBUTING.md prerequisite hook order if applicable. Portable published usage needs no changes; retain dated evidence and separate bug records.

review.reconciliation: Parent and independent reviewer reconciled every task-owned runtime, test, hook, guide, baseline and new artifact addition against the three records. The two pre-existing untracked skill links are excluded and preserved. No removals or renames. This accepts architecture/local checks only; required live integration and release remain open in native tasks and dated evidence.
